scripts.prebuild: powershell -Command "Get-Process knox-desktop,knox -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (Test-Path target\release\knox.exe.old) { Remove-Item -Force target\release\knox.exe.old -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; if (Test-Path target\release\knox.exe) { Move-Item -Path target\release\knox.exe -Destination target\release\knox.exe.old -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; exit 0"
